points: Gideon answers with wisdom: is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer? God delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; what was I able to do in comparison of you? He gave them the best possible situation, the enemy fed right into their hands with nowhere to go, and then their anger was abated toward him.

note.label: Judges 8: Gideon's Pursuit and Israel's Return to Baal

points: “And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb”: destruction, death. “And as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.”

note.label: Buck Breaking and Building God's People

points: “According to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb”: when Gideon destroyed Midian; he’s going to raise up men against them and slaughter them the same way. “As his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt”: like when Moses lifted up his rod.
